notes.subject: אשר
notes.rationale: relative 'that/which' has no standalone Tok Pisin word here; absorbed into verb chain

notes.subject: תהדפו/תנגחו
notes.rationale: two pushing verbs (shoulder-shove and horn-butt) echo each other; Tok Pisin pushim/butim keeps the pair

notes.subject: to the fat sheep/leaders of Israel
notes.rationale: verse directly addresses the strong rams who bully the weak

translation: Long wanem, yu ol long sait na long sekel i pushim ol i go daun, na long ol karn bilong yu ol yet i butim olgeta ol man i no gat strong, inap yu ol yet i skerapredim ⟨את⟩ ol i go long autsait.

tokens.gloss: yu ol i pushim ol i go daun
na long ol karn bilong yu ol yet
ol man i no gat strong
